Géorisques · What to do in a flood (FR)

instructions.title: Plan a refuge up high
instructions.text: Identify an upper floor or a nearby refuge. If the water comes in, move up and only evacuate when the authorities tell you to.

instructions.title: Stay out of the cellar
instructions.text: Move your belongings to safety before the flood. Once the water is rising, never go down into basements or underground car parks.

instructions.title: Your children stay at school
instructions.text: During an alert, do not go and collect your children from school or nursery: staff follow their own safety plan.

instructions.title: Follow the authorities
instructions.text: Check Vigicrues and the instructions from the city hall and the prefecture. Postpone your trips.

instructions.title: Prepare your emergency kit
instructions.text: Pack water, food, medicines, a radio, a torch and key documents in a bag you can grab.

instructions.title: Protect yourself without taking risks
instructions.text: Cut the gas and electricity only if you can do it safely. Never walk or drive into a flooded street.
